name: The Understudy
pitch: Forty per cent of what they throw lands on a double, you buy the rest one mask a second, and every blow that hits nothing comes back as a slap: a top-end spends seven seconds killing silk and never touches you.
channel: basic, and cued arts, from misses

new.name: The Understudy
new.effect: Evade is never rolled. Each body or qi hit fills the Curtain by p_evade times min(1, your thần thức / theirs); at 1 or more it pays 1 and the hit lands on the double: nothing dealt, nothing drained, no on-hit trigger, their cost stays paid. Holds 2. Closes all but one light artifact and any ward gear.

new.name: Cue
new.effect: A guard: true in an instant when a hit landed on the double. The art fires in the follow-up instant.

new.name: Encore
new.effect: +10 points per hit evaded this fight, to +100.
new.second_home: any evade build, rolled or not

new.name: Full House
new.effect: On ground with the stage tag: +30 points, and the Curtain holds 4.

new.name: Dress Rehearsal
new.effect: In a foreseen fight the Curtain starts at 2.

new.name: Seen Through
new.effect: An attacker whose accuracy reaches your evade sees through the double: the Curtain neither fills nor pays for them.

new.name: The Credit
new.effect: A knockout won with the Curtain up is credited to the role: it feeds no tally of cultivators defeated, and the world records the double.

new.name: Costume Change
new.effect: No hit. Adds 1 to the Curtain, times the thần thức ratio. Cost 0.06, cooldown 1 s.

new.name: Painted Screen
new.effect: No hit. Adds 1 to the Curtain, times the thần thức ratio. Cost 0.08, cooldown 2 s.

new.name: Curtain Call
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 1.6, cost 0.05, 1 s, guard Cue.

new.name: Aside
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 2.4, cost 0.08, 3 s, guard Cue.

new.name: Hundred-Mask Libretto
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Water. linh_luc_pct 20, than_thuc_pct 15. Unlocks the five arts.

new.name: Green Room
new.effect: Water, outer, sealed by a technique, size 10. Notables Returned Force and a second for Longer Breath's condition. Capability: a Cue guard on any art.

new.name: Illusion
new.effect: Water at purity 30. theme_stats evade_pct, than_thuc_pct, linh_luc_regen_pct, mi_luc. Branches The Mask, The Script, The House. Keystone The Understudy. 20 nodes. A tree for the catalogue entry that has none.

new.name: The Curtain
new.effect: A keystone may replace one chance roll with a counter that fills at the roll's chance, so a build can rest on it without breaking rule 15.

questions: A Core build beats its own top-end untouched, for its whole pool. Is that wanted, or should a mask cost more?
Is a miss that is bought rather than rolled still inside what evade_cap means?
Should Dao heart be the key that sees through illusions in a fight?
Rule 10 gives the opener first hit, and that alone decides the Understudy against the Forum Build. Should a side be able to choose to open?
Does Measured Stroke's 'cannot be evaded' beat the double? Its text and its file disagree.
